sources: bridge/data/bl_ruler_kits.json (hero kits the overrides apply to)
Modules/*/ModuleData/items/*.xml of the install (every id validated; all are SandBoxCore items, loaded by CustomGame)
how_to_use: 1. For every hero (HeroSpec of a CK3 commander/knight) take the artifacts logged for him (CX|artifact records, PROTOCOL.md §13.2): type key + rarity (+ armor_helmet feature).

2. category = type_to_category[type]; culture = the hero's Bannerlord culture, via culture_fallback when it is not one of cultures; mode = "mounted" when the hero rides (formation Cavalry/HorseArcher and Horse not cleared), else "foot".

3. entry = items[category][culture][rarity][mode]: roles weapon (+ ammo), Head, Body. Resolve roles to equipment slots with placement (weapons) or directly (Head, Body) and add them to equipment.overrides.

4. Never downgrade: keep the kit item when it is of the same class group and has a higher tier (weapons) or more armour (Body/Head). item_info has tier and armour of every id; bl_ruler_kits.json / bl_catalog.json of the kit items.
5. Several artifacts: one primary_armament, one armor and one helmet (crown) slot exist per CK3 character, so at most one entry per role. A crown (helmet slot) wins Head over the armour's helmet.
notes: Bannerlord crafted melee weapons stop at tier 5 (the noble "_t5" pieces); famed and illustrious therefore map to the decorated noble weapons of the culture. Bows and crossbows reach tier 6 (noble_bow, noble_long_bow, crossbow_f).
CK3 hammer has no Bannerlord counterpart (no war hammer item): it uses the mace rows.
Two-handed picks: sturgia/vlandia/empire foot famed+ axes and aserai famed+ axes are two-handed (sturgia_2haxe_2_t5, aserai_2haxe_3_t5), as the culture lord kits already carry them.
Daggers are only added to an empty weapon slot (placement.dagger); they never replace a weapon.

Body armour: styles from the Bannerlord display name (bodyStyles: "Bronze Lamellar over Mail" = lamellar, then mail), ARMOR_STYLE_PREFERENCE per CK3 type; the item of the hero's culture or a neighbour culture with the lowest score |body - goal| + 6 x neighbour + 3 x style rank + 4 x secondary keyword wins; goal = body {"common":30,"masterwork":38,"famed":45,"illustrious":"best of the culture"}. Helmets: head armour closest to {"common":36,"masterwork":42,"famed":47,"illustrious":"max"}, crowns excluded; armor_helmet_by_feature narrows to the CK3 helmet shape.

placement.same_group_first: If a kit weapon slot holds an item whose classes intersect the category class_group, that slot is the target (keep the kit item when its tier is higher).
melee: first slot with a one- or two-handed sword/axe/mace (the kit's main melee weapon)
ranged: the other launcher kind (kit bow for a crossbow artifact and vice versa)
polearm (a second polearm first; the bow is the CK3 primary armament, so it may displace the kit lance)
placement.ammo: Ranged entries carry an ammo id of category ammo_type. Kit ammo of that type is replaced when ours has a higher tier; else the ammo takes the slot of the other ammo type (all of the other ammo is converted), else a free slot (same order as ranged). Without the needed slots the ranged artifact is skipped.
placement.shields: Shields are never replaced by melee or ranged artifacts.
